source_documents.title: Thionated Perylenebisimides as Heavy‐Atom‐Free Triplet Photosensitizers: Intersystem Crossing, Electron Spin Dynamics, and Application in Photodynamic Therapy

reference_evidence_units.quote: The thionation induced intersystem crossing (ISC) in perylenebisimide (PBI) derivatives was studied.
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1 to S-3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Replacing imide C=O by C=S switches on ISC in the PBI chromophore.

reference_evidence_units.quote: The T increases from 98% (S-1) to 100% (S-3), indicating that the ISC efficiency of thionated PBI is very high (determined with ground state bleaching method, using nanosecond transient absorption spectra).
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1, S-3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Triplet yield 98% (S-1) and 100% (S-3), versus 8% for unthionated S-0 (Table 1).

reference_evidence_units.quote: A broad positive absorption band in the range of 400–800 nm was observed (Figure 2a), which is assigned to the triplet state absorption (excited state absorption, ESA), i.e., due to T1 →Tn transitions.
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1

reference_evidence_units.quote: However, the triplet state lifetimes of the compounds are short, τ S-1 = 0.78 µs, τ S-2(trans) = 0.35 µs, τ S-2(cis) = 0.32 µs, and τ S-3 = 0.12 µs.
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1, S-3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Triplet lifetime shortens with each added sulfur (0.78 to 0.12 us; unthionated PBI about 127 us).

reference_evidence_units.quote: These short triplet excited state lifetimes may be attributed to the enhanced SOCs between the T1 and S0 state.
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1 to S-3
reference_evidence_units.statement: Sulfur raises T1-S0 spin-orbit coupling, shortening the triplet.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Previously, the ISC processes of the thionated PBI derivatives were studied with fs-TA spectra,[10,11] and it was found that ISC timescale is ca. 1 ps, much faster than the fluorescence process
reference_evidence_units.subject: thionated PBIs
reference_evidence_units.statement: ISC in about 1 ps outcompetes fluorescence.
reference_evidence_units.limitations: From previous work; not remeasured here.

reference_evidence_units.quote: Based on the similar ZFS D of the thionated PBI derivatives as compared to the ZFS D of that of the triplet state of the unsubstituted PBI,[31] we conclude that the T1 state has π π ∗ character, not nπ ∗ character.
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1 to S-3
reference_evidence_units.statement: TREPR zero-field splitting identifies a pi-pi* T1.

reference_evidence_units.quote: For all neutral compounds, the T1 state has π π * character. The S1 state has nπ * character for all compounds except S-0.
reference_evidence_units.subject: S-1 to S-3 vs S-0
reference_evidence_units.statement: S1 is n-pi* in the thionated dyes, so S1(n-pi*) to T(pi-pi*) ISC is El-Sayed allowed.

reference_mechanisms.label: TRIPLET_ISC_RTP_TADF
reference_mechanisms.rationale: Triplet yield 100%; the extra sulfurs raise T1-S0 spin-orbit coupling and cut the triplet lifetime to 0.12 us (pi-pi* T1 by TREPR).

contrast_group.varied_factor: number of imide C=O groups replaced by C=S on the same N,N'-bis(2-octyldodecyl) PBI (one vs three)
contrast_group.paper_difference: Both reach near-unit triplet yield; the triplet lifetime falls from 0.78 us (S-1) to 0.12 us (S-3) and the singlet oxygen yield from 99% to 11%.

basis: Scheme 1 structures (N-CH2CH(C8H17)(C10H21) imides); compounds made by the cited literature method; three of the four carbonyls thionated (all three-sulfur patterns are equivalent by symmetry)
